established: Input name follows const char* NUL termination; key is produced by GetHashName.
Only when the boolean argument AND g_UseOneTex are true, request HeatDistort.tga while retaining the original cache key.
A null texture result or false boolean argument skips all filtering.
For nonzero CLevel::s_TexTests, set mag=0, then when descriptor byte >1 set anisotropy=0 before min=2; otherwise min=1.
With tests disabled, set mag=1. With g_UseAnisotropy and descriptor byte >1, set min=4 then anisotropy=4; with byte <=1 set min=1 only.
With both tests and g_UseAnisotropy disabled, set min=2 for byte >1 or min=1 otherwise, then set anisotropy from signed DeviceOptions word +0x38 converted to float.

tests.name: scoped_reference_differential
tests.scope: Normal entry-to-return executions from actual reference ARM code, with explicit external helper models. Does not establish every exceptional path, ABI, renderer or engine parity.
tests.filename_corpus: 21 standalone explicit vectors; differential corpus has fixed edges, all strings of length 0..4 over seven selected bytes, 300 seeded arbitrary-byte strings, embedded NULs, all byte values and a 4096-character basename.
tests.texture_corpus: Boolean/descriptor matrix over all 256 descriptor bytes and modes 0/1/255; additional cases cover every test-mode byte, signed conversion boundaries, long names, mixed separators, embedded NULs, null loads and asset substitution.
